notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.notes: [p]Finally![/p][p]It took quite a lot longer than I initially planned, but it's finally here![/p][p]Despite the odd version number, this is a full update (Yes it's gotten that big):[/p][p][/p][p]- a little under 1000 render[/p][p]- 24 animations[/p][p]- fixed several issues with the gallery and I'm still working on expanding it's functionality[/p][p]- fixed issues with the naming option in the settings[/p][p]- added an option for how Jada calls the MC in game, so you can change it whenever you want[/p][p]- fixed and/or reworked parts of a few older scenes[/p][p][/p][p]Finally I'm sad to say that I didn't get much feedback during the beta, so if you encounter any problems, bugs, typos, or something weird, etc., please let me know and I'll have a look at it.[/p][p]Also, have fun and I hope you enjoy the new content :D[/p]

notes.title: Small delay and update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope y'all doing good?

So, I have to make an unfortunate announcement, but don't worry, it's nothing too badːpeekː
I simply have to delay the current update a bit and there are several reasons for that:
Firstly I was pretty sick last week and barely managed to do anything.
Secondly the current scene I'm working on just takes waaayyyy too long in regards to render times. Nowadays we're pretty spoiled in regards to render times, so I really didn't expect any render to take even anywhere near an hour, but several of those I'm currently working on took even more than an hour to render (and that doesn't include the scene creation).
Lastly, I want to add a bit more content than I had initially planned for this update, so even without all the delays, I'd probably not be able to release this month with the additional content.

I could've probably said something sooner, but I felt really shitty last week, so it didn't even come to my mind at the time. I hope that's understandable.
Anyway, here's a little tease if you will, some might be able to see some story relevance here ;)

notes.title: Update and other things
notes.notes:
Hello! ːpeekː

I've just finished one of the scenes for the upcoming update, and thought "this might be a good time for a news post", so here goes...

One thing I want to make clear right from the start: I still don't know when the update will be done, but it shouldn't take too long anymore.

So, as many of you know, I've been back in my home country for a few weeks, settle some things, get the last bits and pieces of my stuff, etc.. most of my stuff comes with a container ship in one or two months, but I took some hardware from my old render pc with me (so I won't have to wait for it to arrive with the container), and I'm already using it effectively. Render times have decreased a lot!

Anyway, I know most of you just want to know about the update:
Currently there are 7 scenes more or less finished. There are scenes for all of the girls (side, and main), and the main story progresses as well. I'm still working on some render and animations for some of them, but they're mostly done.
I still have to do one bigger scene and some minor scenes in between, to connect everything, but after that, there's only testing and the beta release, which usually takes about two weeks, after that the full update will release.

I should mention that I've decided to not switch to WS after this update, but to go right back to BM. The way I've planned things out, it makes more sense to keep working on BM. I could, of course, just release one huge update, but there's just so much left to do, that I prefer to not do that.
Nonetheless, this update should still be the biggest to date (content wise).

I'm also planning to release a SFW version of BM (Steam only), which requires some additional work, but it shouldn't affect the update much. This will make it possible to release BM in countries where Lewd stuff is not available on steam, but with a small (free) patch, it can be converted back to NSFW.

So yeah, that's all for now. Stay tuned for more soon 😉

notes.title: Minor patch for "thoughts"
notes.notes:
This is just a little change to the thoughts text color and some text that is neither thought, nor said, but shows up in the dialogue textbox (for example: "please enter your name").
It should be readable without this change, but for some people it wasn't, so with this patch I hope it fixes it for them.
If it doesn't change anything in your game, verify the game from your steam library > right click > properties > local files.

notes.title: Update 0.8.5; QOL improvements and more!
notes.notes:
Hey there lovely people ;)

Here's a little update with just one new scene, but a lot of technical improvements.
Be sure to check the Settings/Preferences.
Also, if you want to see the full new scene, you need to be on the harem route, and on Jada' and Rachel's route.

Here's the Changelog for v0.8.5:

- 171 Render
- 10 Animations
- fixed the Gallery
- added new scenes from 0.8+ to the gallery
- reworked the Settings (aka preferences) menu
- added some QOL settings (see the settings menu)
- general QOL improvements
- fixed some code issues
- added italian and french languages (fan translated!!). Currently at 0.8, not updated to 0.8.5, yet, e.g. the last scene is not translated!

Have fun, and let me know what you think about the improvements (and the scene *wink*).

notes.title: Update 0.8 is finalle here!
notes.notes:
It took a lot longer than expected, but if you followed the News on here, you'll know that my RL got in the way.
I know some people were eagerly waiting for the update, so sorry again for the long delay.

Anyway, here are the Details/the Changelog for the update:

- there are 972 new Render
- 27 new animations
- I've made some major code changes/improvements
- this time it's a more story focused update, but there are still some (new) naughty bits
- aside from the main story, there's also a pretty long and hot scene with Steph (the co-worker), and I can [b]really[/b] only recommend to go for it, even if you didn't pursue her, yet.
- Improved and corrected some older scenes, including renders and dialogues
- changed the map layout somewhat to make room for future scenes/places
- Gallery update will come at a later point, I haven't added the new scenes, yet.

That's it so far. Saves from the last update should work, but I had some trouble with saves specifically from (ingame) day 11, day 12 and pre- day 11 saves worked though, as long as they're not too old (several updates behind).

Alright, that's it, have fun playing, enjoy!

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Yep, it's getting closer.

The Beta will be available some time in May for patrons/subscriber in Tester/Stalker tier and up. It will be availabe for one to two weeks, depending on the feedback and necessary fixes.

I'm currently at 583 render, so already more than I had expected, and I'm still not entirely sure how much more it will be, but 600 should be easy^^
Depending on how the beta goes, I might do some additional animations or render, but we'll see how it goes ;)

[b]For those of you that don't follow the community posts here, and as a reminder to everyone else:[/b]
I'm using a different animation technique now, which I had to learn how to use, so the first one and a half months or so (all of january and a good part of february), I did basically just testing and practicing.
I'm still not entirely happy with the results, but I'm at a point where they're good enough so I don't feel bad to include the animations in the game anymore.
(I might add one or two of my early attempts in the special gallery, so you have something to laugh about)
Why am I telling you this?
Well it means two things: the time I had for the update wasn't as long as it looks from the outside, which means there won't be as much content as in the last update, but it also means animations will be easier and therefore faster to create from now on.

[i][b]For those of you interested in testing the beta, PLEASE READ![/b][/i]
First and most importantly:
-When I say Beta, I mean it! I know a lot of studios and/or devs see betas as some kind of promotion material, but this isn't the case here.
[b]There will be bugs and there will be stuff missing[/b], this may or may not include: render, animations, full scenes and/or paths/routes.
-I still haven't found the time to get access to the beta channel here on steam, so for now the beta will only be accessible for patreons/subscriber on the Tester/Stalker tier and up.
-The download will only be available on my official discord server, and you'll have to link your patreon/subscribestar account to discord to be able to access the channel.
[i]I know this is quite the hassle, but it's mainly to prevent early leaks and to reduce the workload and time I rather spend on finishing the update.[/i]

Stay tuned!
